subject.title: fix(review): bind mutations to reviewed activity

question: Should live review, apply, and automerge mutations adopt this 1,000-record fail-closed activity cursor now, including pausing cursor-less legacy verdicts until refreshed?
rationale: The patch deliberately trades automation continuity and additional GitHub API calls for a stronger human-review freshness boundary; tests cannot choose that operational security policy.

options.title: Adopt with a monitored canary
options.body: Accept the fail-closed cursor contract, run a live non-production canary covering legacy refresh and late human activity, then merge if mutation blocking and API usage behave as intended.

options.title: Add rollout controls first
options.body: Require explicit telemetry or staged enablement before applying the new guard to every live mutation family.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land review and apply freshness first while deferring trusted automerge enforcement to a smaller follow-up.

recommendation.title: Adopt with a monitored canary
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed cursor contract, run a live non-production canary covering legacy refresh and late human activity, then merge if mutation blocking and API usage behave as intended.
